research_question: Can a previous-active-UTC-day high/low sweep followed by a causal completed-bar reclaim add independent first-entry opportunities to the frozen 14A surrogate parent without the discovery-only instability seen in SORB?
structural_independence: Level is inherited from the fully completed prior active UTC day, not built from the current session opening range.
Signal requires failed expansion beyond a fixed prior-day extreme and reclaim back inside, not breakout continuation.
No dependency on a just-closed DELTA trade, same-minute rearm, bracket recenter, or SORB range duration.
At most one consumed event per PDH and PDL per UTC day.

level_definition.previous_day: most recent earlier UTC day containing at least one canonical tick
level_definition.PDH: maximum Bid of that completed active day
level_definition.PDL: minimum Bid of that completed active day
level_definition.first_available_day: No signal until a prior active day is fully observed.
